nodes.label: Accuracy Bottlenecks
nodes.rationale: The README says the main bottleneck is label and GIS quality, not model choice, and prioritizes negatives plus better road, drainage, and raster data.

nodes.label: LLM Not Primary Predictor
nodes.rationale: The README states culvert prediction is spatial rather than language-only and warns that LLMs can hallucinate coordinates unless constrained to extraction or QA.

nodes.label: Field Search Time Bottleneck
nodes.rationale: The notes frame locating culverts before inspection as a major time bottleneck that ranked geospatial predictions should reduce.

nodes.label: LLM Role Boundary
nodes.rationale: The notes say LLMs may check messy report text but should not invent coordinates or replace the GIS/model workflow.

nodes.label: Missed Road Feedback Rationale
nodes.rationale: The model notes explain that roads with field culverts but no predictions expose missing candidates, weak GIS evidence, insufficient examples, or unrepresented field patterns.

nodes.label: Bottlenecks
nodes.rationale: The track file lists the next constraints as negative labels, durable Blob persistence, official GIS layers, hydrology rasters, and route-clustered validation.
